name: Scoop
readme_excerpt: Scoop Features Installation Documentation Scoop is a command-line installer for Windows. What does Scoop do? Scoop installs apps from the command line with a minimal amount of friction. It: - Eliminates User Account Control (UAC) prompt notifications. - Hides the graphical user interface (GUI) of wizard-style installers. - Prevents polluting the PATH environment variable.
